description: Source file implementing the PlayerInfo plugin for WPEFramework, managing player properties, codecs, and related notifications.

classes.name: PlayerInfo
classes.description: Main class implementing the PlayerInfo plugin, handling initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PlayerInfo plugin, setting up codecs, notifications, and Dolby output if available.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, releases codecs, and terminates connections.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently no implementation.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, primarily GET requests to return player codec information in JSON format.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Populates the JSON response with current audio and video codecs.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation events, scheduling cleanup.
